profile.headline: Senior QA Manager & Tech Lead specializing in enterprise workflow validation, automation strategy, and AI-assisted QA innovation
profile.summary:
I am Heajin Kim, a QA Engineering professional experienced in implementing impactful test strategies across payment processing systems, CRM platforms, and enterprise content management solutions, ensuring seamless integration with tools like Zuora and Salesforce. 
•	I excel in designing API testing frameworks using Postman, Newman, and GitHub, supporting continuous testing within CI/CD pipelines, and optimizing development workflows. 
•	Skilled in leading cross-functional global teams through complex test scenarios, defect management, and performance optimization, I ensure compliance with financial data regulations while reducing manual effort through boundary value analysis, system integration testing, and automated test implementation.
•	As an aspiring Prompt Engineer, I bring foundational knowledge in test automation and system requirement analysis, currently pursuing certification in prompt engineering. 
•	I am passionate about designing AI prompting strategies and leveraging programming languages like JavaScript and Python, alongside cloud platforms and CI/CD processes, to implement innovative AI-driven solutions. 
•	My goal is to translate business needs into technical solutions, improve operational workflows, and enhance software reliability through creative problem-solving and emerging technologies.
Areas of Expertise
•	Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering
•	Regression Testing Management
•	Risk-Based Testing Prioritization
•	Payment Processing Validation
•	Test Strategy Implementation
•	End-to-End System Integration Testing
•	Performance Bottleneck Identification
•	User Experience & Usability Testing
•	Data Integrity & Validation Testing
•	API Endpoint Testing & Validation
•	Test Case Design & Optimization
•	Test Environment Configuration
•	Release Readiness Assessment
•	Quality Gate Implementation
•	Root Cause Identification
Technical Proficiencies
•	Testing & QA Tools: JIRA | TestRail | Postman | JMeter
•	Payment & CRM Platforms: Zuora | Salesforce CRM
•	Test Automation, CI/CD: GitHub Actions | Jenkins | JMeter Perf Testing
•	Languages: JavaScript | Python | Bash | C | C++ | COBOL | Pascal	
•	Databases: MongoDB | Snowflake | MSSQL | DB2 | Oracle
•	Version Control & CI/CD: Git | Jenkins
•	Cloud Platforms: AWS | SoftLayer
•	Methodologies: Agile | Scrum | High Availability | Disaster Recovery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & QA Manager
positions.description:
Built and scaled QA engineering capabilities across enterprise workflow platforms while driving modernization initiatives across QA engineering practices, release validation, and backend workflow testing.
Serve as both a hands-on technical lead and engineering manager, balancing team leadership, release coordination, backend automation architecture, and enterprise workflow validation across multiple Agile teams.
Focused on designing scalable, low-maintenance automation platforms using API orchestration, backend validation, configuration-driven execution models, and workflow lifecycle automation.
Key areas of impact:
• Designed and delivered a Notification E2E Automation Framework using configuration-driven orchestration and MongoDB backend validation
• Built reusable automation platforms supporting scalable regression coverage with minimal operational overhead
• Developed AU lifecycle automation with runtime calculation logic and environment-aware validation models
• Validated workflow consistency across REST APIs, MongoDB, Snowflake, and enterprise business processes
• Collaborated with DevOps teams on CI/CD-integrated automation execution workflows
• Leveraged AI-augmented development workflows using Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate automation design and implementation
Environment: Python, Postman/Newman, MongoDB, Snowflake, GitHub Actions, Jira, TestRail, Salesforce, Zuora

positions.title: Senior Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
Built and scaled QA engineering capabilities across enterprise workflow platforms while driving modernization initiatives across QA engineering practices, release validation, and backend workflow testing.

Serving as both a hands-on technical lead and engineering manager, balancing team leadership, release coordination, backend automation architecture, and enterprise workflow validation.

Helped build and scale the QA engineering organization by mentoring engineers toward stronger automation, backend validation, and enterprise-quality engineering practices. Collaborate closely with DevOps, engineering, product, analytics, and business teams to support release readiness and production stability across multiple Agile teams.

Technical focus areas include designing scalable, low-maintenance automation platforms centered around API orchestration, backend validation, configuration-driven execution models, and workflow lifecycle automation rather than high-overhead UI automation.

Key areas of impact include:

• Building reusable automation platforms supporting scalable regression coverage with minimal operational overhead
• Developing AU lifecycle automation with runtime calculation logic and environment-aware validation models
• Validating workflow consistency across REST APIs, MongoDB, Snowflake, and enterprise business processes to identify synchronization and ETL-related issues
• Collaborating with DevOps teams on CI/CD-integrated automation execution workflows
• Leveraging AI-augmented development workflows using Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate automation design, implementation, and validation

Environment: Python, Postman/Newman, MongoDB, Snowflake, GitHub Actions, Jira, TestRail, Salesforce, Zuora

positions.title: Senior Engineer – QA
positions.description:
During this tenure, I validated the accuracy of financial and subscription data by leading testing efforts for Oracle-based warehouse management and reporting systems. My role involved ensuring high-quality releases through black-box, regression, and usability testing for finance-related applications, while supporting day-to-day business operations with reliable financial data.
Key Contributions:
•	Data Validation: Ensured the accuracy of financial and subscription data by testing Oracle-based warehouse management and reporting systems.
•	Quality Assurance: Conducted black-box, regression, and usability testing to guarantee high-quality releases for finance-related applications.
•	Operational Support: Expedited business operations by compiling and delivering dependable financial data and insights.
